name: Dr Xand's Con or Cure
description: From cons to cures, scams to scares and sifting fakes from facts. Dr Xand van Tulleken and Ashley John-Baptiste’s health consumer show, dedicated to righting the wrongs of ‘bad medicine’.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: The dangers of health tourism – a mother and daughter talk of their surgery abroad that went badly wrong. And we ask the question: can being cold give you the cold?

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: The shocking story of fake DNA paternity tests. Testing the three-second-rule – is it safe to eat food off the floor? And we investigate a new social media trend, 'The Lion Diet'.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: The dangers of a dodgy hair transplant, a health crime so shocking a former doctor is serving 20 years in prison, and we ask – do you really feed a cold and starve a fever?

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: What to look out for when considering dentistry abroad, the scammers who prey on sick people, and does CBD oil live up to the hype when it comes to health benefits?

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: Is gut health really the key to good health, the fake medicines being touted as ‘cures’ for autism, and we ask, is 'exercise snacking’ really a quick fix that works?

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: The incredible story of the woman who can smell Parkinson's, and we discover that alcohol does not dehydrate you.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: Cheap teeth whitening kits – are they ever safe? Do we really need less sleep as we get older? And, it was the largest maternity scandal in the UK, but have things really changed?

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: The scammers cashing in on long Covid, the con artists treating mental health as a money-making scheme, and the truth about exercise and weight loss.

videos.title: Episode 9
videos.overview: The deadly effects of diet pills. Is breakfast really the most important meal of the day? And is bone broth a cure or a con?

videos.title: Episode 10
videos.overview: The woman who raised thousands of pounds for her best friend’s cancer treatment, only to find out the diagnosis was a lie. And we test whether 10,000 steps really is a magic number.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: A look at a revolutionary treatment for depression available on the high street. What gadgets can help treat seasonal affective disorder? Is neck cracking dangerous? And can cheese cause nightmares?

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: Can eating spicy curry cause ulcers? Advice on helping someone with an eating disorder. Beware of the small print in your travel insurance. And gadgets to help with headaches.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: Do detoxing gadgets work? Tips on helping us with our sleep. A revolutionary scientific advance that might spell the end of mammograms. And the dangers of weight loss surgery abroad.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: Can a public toilet seat cause infectious diseases? Are non-branded painkillers OK? Also, the woman who spent £25,000 on a cure that was a con and the dangers of low-cost cosmetic surgery.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: Is there a cure for a hangover? Can drinking celery juice help with weight loss? Also, a look at the dangers of DIY dentistry and advice on dealing with tinnitus.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: A look at some of the latest back pain gadgets and robotic pets that help people with dementia. There's also a shocking tale of care home abuse. And is stifling a sneeze dangerous?

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: A look at the baby hearing test scandal and the dangers of home gel nail kits. Also, does reading in dim light damage our eyes, and can ice cure acne?

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: The dangers of home dental kits, how to be healthy in old age and the latest on painful mesh implants.

videos.title: Episode 9
videos.overview: The dangers of using antidepressants long term, how to deal with stress, and the groundbreaking virtual reality treatment for stroke and brain injuries. Also, is aloe vera juice good for you?

videos.title: Episode 10
videos.overview: A look at the online weight loss drugs that could kill you. Are allergy nasal sprays addictive, and can you die of a broken heart? Plus, the dangers of tattoo numbing cream.

videos.title: Episode 11
videos.overview: A look at eye supplements and the dangers of buying prescription medication online. Also, is there a cure for hiccups, and can a red onion drink cure the cold?

videos.title: Episode 12
videos.overview: The dangers of long-term steroid use for eczema. How to stop snoring. Can a base tan prevent sunburn? And why drinking saltwater can be fatal.

videos.title: Episode 13
videos.overview: Are collagen supplements worth the money? Do microwaves remove the goodness from food? And is tongue scraping a good idea?

videos.title: Episode 14
videos.overview: Can spices help with our health? Is drinking lettuce juice the key to a good night’s sleep? Are online food intolerance tests worth the money? And a look at the dangers of aerosol cans.

videos.title: Episode 15
videos.overview: Tips on getting a good night’s sleep, and is castor oil a cure-all? Also, a look at the dangers of skin-lightening creams, and whether crossing your legs can cause varicose veins.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: Brazilian butt lift dangers, the robot transforming one boy’s experience of cancer, choosing the right toothpaste, and should we drink pickle juice?

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: Ashley John-Baptiste goes to the moon and back to explore new treatments for pain, devised for astronauts. Dr Xand gets to the truth of why we get sick when we have time off. And is there anything that can help about long Covid symptoms?

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: Scammers targeting funerals, the contraceptive device causing pain, and the dangers of cotton buds.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: Protecting ourselves from financial scams, the addictive dangers of a hair loss drug, and does drinking alcohol help keep us warm in cold weather?

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: The cheap deals for cosmetic surgery that left people out of pocket, can stress turn our hair grey, and why electric toothbrushes really are worth the money.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: The criminals selling fake or stolen disabled blue badges, plus the latest gizmos and gadgets for bunions, plantar fasciitis and other foot issues. But do any of them work?

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: With whooping cough on the rise, there is confusion over vaccines and who should get one. And what’s the right number per day when it comes to having a poo?

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: Are meal replacement drinks really a healthy alternative? And Dr Xand shares what we can do to check out the medical professionals who treat us.

videos.title: Episode 9
videos.overview: The beauticians illegally offering dodgy injectables without a prescription. And is it safe to swallow chewing gum?

videos.title: Episode 10
videos.overview: Dr Xand investigates a common prescription drug with horrific withdrawal symptoms. Also on the programme, the effects of late-night eating on sleep and weight gain. And the incredible story of a condition that makes sufferers drunk without drinking alcohol.

videos.title: Episode 11
videos.overview: Delayed discharges keeping hundreds of young people locked in hospitals, the effectiveness of gut health drinks exposed, and the importance of cervical screening.

videos.title: Episode 12
videos.overview: Beauty salons breaking the law by selling hay fever injections, frozen food v fresh food, and why placebo is so effective.

videos.title: Episode 13
videos.overview: A terminally ill patient whose insurance didn’t cover him, how healthy is it to eat honey?, what to do if your surgery has gone wrong, and does apple cider vinegar work for weight loss?

videos.title: Episode 14
videos.overview: The dangers of nicotine pouches and patches, mixing lemon juice and coffee for supposed health benefits, and the rise of bootleg weight-loss jabs.

videos.title: Episode 15
videos.overview: How to fall safely, the pros and cons of milk alternatives, and how a private ADHD diagnosis doesn’t guarantee access to the necessary medications on the NHS.
